invalid_session_id.title: Session ID is invalid
invalid_session_id.description: The ICA integration cannot fetch data. Click Fix to paste a fresh session ID without removing the integration.

abort.entry_not_found: The ICA Shopping config entry no longer exists.

confirm.title: Update the ICA session ID
confirm.description: Log into ica.se in a browser, copy the `thSessionId` cookie value, and paste it below.

list_missing.title: ICA shopping list not found
list_missing.description: The list {list_id} is no longer on your ICA account, so syncing is paused and nothing is changed. Select the current list in the integration options.

sync_aborted.title: ICA sync stopped to protect your lists
sync_aborted.description: One sync would have removed {count} items at once (the limit is {limit}), so nothing was changed. Check both lists, then run the service ica_shopping.refresh with force enabled if the removals are correct.

remove_striked_both.name: Remove checked and completed items
remove_striked_both.description: Removes checked rows from ICA and completed items from Keep
